name: bob-jones-qwen3-06b
reference_text: Seisan is a very interesting kata because it comes in at third degree, the teacher's level. Also, it is a kata through meditation we get to understand when we're being attacked by several people, five to eight people, that have actually got in close enough to grab hold of us.
